verdict.rationale: Raygun's dashboard supports some bulk actions - exporting all or selected error groups (docs-9) and rule-based bulk ignoring by time/occurrence/rule (docs-11) - which show basic bulk operation support, and an MCP server exists (probe-3) that could enable AI-agent-driven actions. However there's no documented evidence of bulk resolve, bulk tagging, or programmatic bulk operations exposed via API/MCP for AI-native workflows. missing for 10: evidence of bulk resolve/tag/assign via API, MCP-server bulk-operation examples, or automation-scale bulk actions beyond export/ignore rules.
